json.nextStep: To perform it, call facebook_delete_post again with the same arguments plus apply:true and plan_id:"<uuid>".
json.notPerformedNotice: This was a dry run — the post was NOT deleted and still exists.
warnings: Deleting a Page post is permanent: there is no undo and no trash to restore it from.
Facebook only lets an app edit posts that the SAME app created. Editing a post published by another app, or by a human in the Page UI, fails no matter what permissions the token carries (CC-PUB-4).
If the post is already gone, the delete reports success-with-note instead of an error — absence is the intended end state (CC-PUB-5).
"irreversible" writes must bind apply:true to a plan_id from a prior plan step
